messages:
tasha: Quick sync  we're adding a 'shelter mode' operator path to rollouts. Idea: lightweight, audited override that nudges traffic to a fallback for a TTL.
elena: Love the name. Requirements: who, why, ttl, and cost delta must be recorded. No silent reverts.
sam: Will the console expose dry-run/simulate? We should let operators preview 'would-shelter' events without touching routing.
kai: Yes. UI: topbar button -> modal: choose fallback, ttl, reason (required), checkbox: dry-run. Show estimated cost/hr change.
tasha: Telemetry tags proposal: shelter.v1.source=(auto|operator|dryrun), shelter.v1.fallback_model, shelter.v1.cost_delta_usd, shelter.v1.expired=true/false.
elena: Audit event example (single-line): "event:shelter.apply;actor:tasha;scope:route:/search;from:search-large-v3;to:search-small-q2;ttl_s:1800;reason:mitigating 5xx spike;cost_delta_hr:-9.60;ts:1777777800"
audit-bot: logged audit event id=aud-9001 ts=1777777801
sam: Backend: append-only events + explicit ttl_expiry event. Operator override requires explicit cancel or expiry event shows up.
kai: Block apply if fallback has no quota/capacity and show remediation link.
tasha: MVP decisions: implement observe-only (telemetry), apply-with-audit (TTL), and dry-run. Chain targets and auto-rollback later.
elena: I'll write trigger defs & migration plan. Sam will draft telemetry schema. Kai will add quota check flow.
sam: I'll open RFC with sample API: POST /rollouts/{id}/shelter-actions {action:apply|dryrun|cancel, fallback, ttl_s, reason} -> returns {before_hash, after_hash, cost_estimate}.
tasha: Cool. Keep the action visible in rollout header and add a small "why" card on the timeline listing top signals. :thumbsup:
